description: The project's environment variables BY NAME: whether each is set, whether the analysis declared it, when it was last written, and — for a non-secret variable — its value. A name that is required and not set is what holds a project in awaiting_secrets. A value shown here was written with set_env and secret=false, and it survives a re-analysis; a SECRET that is set but not declared was added by hand and will not. No secret value is returned here or anywhere — see get_secrets_link.
name: list_env_names
title: List environment variable names
